name: wbggemsdoe1-lidar-scarp-coh-nms-offcat-36800-20261029-zeros
submission_note: LiDAR scarp excess x coherence NMS; 36,800 off-catalogue dots; no fitted model; holdout unverified
hypothesis: Unmapped fault scarps leave short-wavelength slope excess (ex_max) that is coherent along strike (coh100); NMS peaks of ex_max x coh100 outside a 3 px (300 m) halo of the mapped catalogue are off-catalogue fault candidates.
mechanism: Scarp crest: concentrated short-wavelength slope excess (ex_max) with linear coherence along strike (coh100); peak survival under non-maximum suppression (NMS) and the 5 px spacing rule.
named_non_fault_mimic: Roads, canal and ditch banks, channel banks, terrace risers, paleo-shorelines landslide headscarps and mines (caveats listed in data/external/lidar_scarp_features.json).

holdout.scope: catalogue hide-and-recover, fold-safe replay: dots regenerated per fold from visible catalogue only
holdout.selection_caveat: Best of three variants on the same holdout; no independent split was used.

correlation_overlap_vs_registry.scope: focus-site repos (GEMSDOE24,25,27,28,30,31,32,33,36) + repo downloads; not the full 24-repo registry

validator.validation_class: local format/range preflight; not organizer acceptance or uniqueness clearance
validator.warning: FORMAT PASS is not uniqueness, scientific efficacy, organizer acceptance or slot approval.

decision.reason: Format-valid and unique, but the project promotion gate requires a holdout that beats the best same-evaluator result; this file beats only a random control, by a small paired margin. No leaderboard score is projected.

nine_site_geometry_vs_reported.caveat: n=9; reported scores are USER-REPORTED and unverified; correlation, not causation

irregularities: I1
The portal error 'Predicted values must be in range [0, 1]' is not reproducible here; the portal is login-walled. Our file has no NaN and values in [0,1].
I2

The official rules allow null or NaN outside the bounds. Our file has no NaN cells (validator), so every cell holds a finite 0 or 1. Organizer acceptance of finite zeros outside the footprint is not verified.
I3

data/bridge/sample_submission.tif is not all-zero: it holds 60,988 pixels equal to 1 (the mapped catalogue) and NaN outside the 5,167,373-cell footprint. The official page says the sample predicts total fault absence. The two disagree.
I4

A recorded holdout value cannot be reproduced by re-scoring the final TIFF. The WBG-3 TIFF scores 0.003987 on the same folds, but its recorded value is 0.121862, because that lane regenerated dots inside each fold. A catalogue-trained TIFF has no single file-level holdout score.
I5
The 'gems-segment-pooled-v1' evaluator has no implementing code in this repository or in the 6GEMSDOE mirror. Benchmarks based on it are unverified here.
I6
The prompt gives the leaderboard top as 0.4413, and the repo notes say 0.4544. The page fetched on 2026-10-29 shows #1 at 0.4544 with no cache time. This is flagged, not resolved.
I7

LiDAR coverage is partial and was not re-measured in this session (see data/external/lidar_scarp_features.json). The LiDAR feature responds to roads, channels, terrace risers and other steps, so it is not a fault detector by construction.
I8

The nearest registry raster is a sibling LiDAR file created today (GEMSDOE24 geo1 concealed-conduit, 20261029) at about 64–65% dot overlap. It passes the 70% rule with a margin of about 5 points, which is a lane-proximity risk to review.
I9
The uniqueness check covers 519 rasters from the nine focus-site repos and this repo's downloads. The full 24-repo registry cited in other receipts was not available.

The holdout scores recovery of known catalogue faults. The organizer scores new faults. The repo's own check finds the shared holdout does not rank submissions (Spearman 0.144, n=118, AGENTS.md). Holdout DTI is therefore not a leaderboard estimate.
Three variants were tested on one holdout, and the best paired interval was selected. That selection is a source of optimism.

All nine focus-site scores are USER-REPORTED, not organizer-confirmed. The distance-to-catalogue ordering uses nine points, and it was noticed after the scores were known, so the rank correlation is post hoc.

The literal uniqueness rule (≥70% 3 px dot overlap or Spearman >0.90) flags about 100 non-self registry rasters for each of the nine focus files. About half are dense binary rasters (a density artifact of the literal gate); the rest form a shared family. The nine files are therefore NOT unique in this corpus. Our coherence candidate's maximum on the same rule is 0.6424.

The shared validator reports run_card_matches_exact_tiff = false and run_card_path = null for the selected TIFF. The run card is not yet linked to the exact bytes; this is a blocker for any promotion.
The exmax and halo15 run cards still reference their original docs/downloads paths, which have been moved to evidence/scarp_offcat/negative/. Their SHA-256 values are recorded in the negative folder.
